title: BerDiff: Conditional Bernoulli Diffusion Model for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Conditional diffusion with Bernoulli noise instead of Gaussian for binary masks; multiple samples give diverse plausible masks and an uncertainty view.
evidence: R: beats recent SOTA on two medical datasets of different modalities (abstract, no numbers on page).
adaptation: Base diffusion process for the UMBD arm, or a standalone crack-binary refiner conditioned on [EL, house p(crack)]; average several samples as a cheap ensemble, which may suit jittered 1 to 2 px labels.
min_experiment: Arm: BerDiff refiner on crack channel, 5 samples averaged. Baseline: house ensemble. Metric: relF1@2, crack IoU. Kill: relF1@2 < +0.01.
